input:
can you confirm if the new reporting module is live? We’re trying to pull policyholder data for Q3 reserves.
The user is unsure whether the new reporting module is active, which blocks their ability to retrieve data.

Could you walk me through how to update the reserves section after a claim is approved?
The user does not know how to update the reserves section after a claim is approved.

Hi Bryn, I’m having trouble attaching the right files to the claim — it keeps rejecting them even though I’m sure they’re the correct format.
Users cannot attach files to a claim because the system rejects them even when the format is correct.

Our motor team handles high-volume cases and wants automatic assignment based on postcode and workload... manual claim routing slows them down too much.
Manual claim routing slows down the high-volume motor team.

Also, when we upload garage estimates, they land under Correspondence — that incorrect file type is causing handlers to manually re-categorise everything.
Garage estimate files are incorrectly categorized as Correspondence, requiring manual re‑categorisation.

That’s what I suspected — our IT team is looking into the customer network failure now. Sorry for the false alarm.
The platform reports errors caused by the customer's network failure, resulting in a false alarm.

The claim reference is A17-MAR-0089. We’ve already reprocessed the documents twice but the reserves still aren’t updating in the reporting tab.
Reserves are not updating in the reporting tab even after reprocessing documents.

when a handler needs to adjust a reserve beyond their limit, it goes into an approval waiting list — but if the approver’s out, nothing moves.
Reserve adjustments get stuck in an approval queue when the designated approver is unavailable.

Some tasks are getting stuck in the queue.
Tasks are getting stuck in the queue because of how roles are assigned to claims handlers.

I’ve got a few things I need help with on the claims platform — mostly around documents and reporting.
The user is struggling to manage documents and generate reports on the claims platform.

I need to reset my password for accessing the claims documents portal — can you guide me through that?
The user cannot log in because they forgot their password.

Not right now — just the approval waiting list is the big blocker.
The approval waiting list is causing a major delay.

are we still on track for claim progress messages via SMS and email by Q1 2027?...Our policyholders are expecting updates at key milestones.
The customer is unsure if claim progress messages via SMS and email will be delivered on schedule.

Your interface changes lately — controls moving without warning — it’s forcing us to retrain staff constantly, and unannounced screen changes are disrupting our operations... We’d prefer fewer, bundled changes with previews — unannounced screen changes are hurting our efficiency and we need advance notice to adapt properly.
Frequent, unannounced interface changes force staff retraining and disrupt operations.

Yes, I reset it yesterday and still can’t view the reserves or generate supplier payments reports. It’s ... weekly reporting.
The user cannot view reserves or generate supplier payment reports after a reset.

click "Document type", rage x5...click "Save"
The user gets frustrated when trying to select a document type in the Documents section.

That would help — I’d like to go over the suppliers tab and ensure our payment workflows are aligned with policyholders’ expectations.
The user cannot easily verify that supplier payment workflows match policyholder expectations.

That makes sense — we’ve had issues before with our VPN and the SSO provider. I’ll try bypassing them and get back to you.
The user cannot access the platform because their VPN and SSO provider are causing authentication issues.

I’m managing several claims with lots of supporting documents, and doing them one by one is slowing things down.
The user has to add supporting documents to each claim individually, which slows down handling multiple claims.

Also, we’re still stuck calling garages manually because the system doesn’t show live repair updates — it’s a daily headache... The repair updates missing is a daily blocker — we have to call every garage to get status, which interrupts our handling workflow and delays settlements.
The system lacks live repair updates, forcing manual calls to garages.

Also, our finance team needs clearer reporting on reserves versus actual payments — it’s ... causing delays in supplier reconciliation.
The finance team lacks clear reporting on reserves versus actual payments, causing delays in supplier reconciliation.

Hi Bryn, we’re seeing claims stuck because reserve changes need approval but no one’s covering for the approver right now.
Claims get stuck because reserve changes require approval and there is no approver available.

Our team relies on this being seamless.
The team needs a seamless experience when using the claims platform.

Also, when we’re uploading evidence for a claim, it’s tedious to add each file one at a time... we really need the ability to use multiple file upload to batch-add documents to a claim.
Uploading evidence files one by one is tedious and slows down claim processing.

we rely on those tasks being visible to avoid delays with supplier payments
Tasks are not always visible, leading to potential delays in supplier payments.

Just to confirm — will the letters to policyholders also reflect the corrected reserves after this sync?
The customer is unsure if the policyholder letters will show the updated reserves after a sync.

That’s a welcome update — we’ve been needing better task tracking.
The customer lacks effective task tracking for their claims work.

Also, every time we upload a garage estimate, it lands in correspondence — it’s a wrong document category and handlers keep missing key evidence because of it.
Garage estimate documents are automatically placed in the wrong category, causing handlers to miss important evidence.

Also, we need a sandbox environment to test fraud detection rules before rolling them out live — can that be prioritized? ... We’re risking false positives in production without a safe testing environment.
The team lacks a sandbox to safely test fraud detection rules before deploying them live.

They’re all on SSO through our internal IdP — we haven’t changed anything on our end, but it’s been happening since this morning.
Users cannot log in via SSO after a change on the provider side.

click "Details" ... click "Save", rage x3
Users get frustrated because saving claim details requires multiple clicks.

Can you walk me through how to assign roles to new team members when they join our claims handling workflow?
They are unsure how to assign roles to new team members within their claims handling workflow.

dashboard totals don’t match what they export, and they’re worried the numbers aren’t reliable for reporting
The finance team cannot trust the dashboard because the totals differ from exported data.

handlers are wasting time fixing incorrect file type assignments, and it’s impacting claim accuracy
Handlers waste time fixing incorrectly assigned file types, hurting claim accuracy.

we had to retrain three people just to find the new location, and someone even submitted a payment in error because the button moved... unexpected interface changes moved key controls without warning — it’s causing real errors in claims and payments.
Unexpected interface changes move key controls, forcing staff retraining and causing errors in claims and payments.

I need to reset my password for the claims portal because I can’t access my account right now.
The user cannot log into the claims portal because they have forgotten their password.

when a policyholder reports a loss both by phone and through the web portal, the system doesn’t flag it as a potential duplicate... We end up with two separate claims for the same event, which complicates reserves and payments.
The system fails to detect duplicate loss reports, creating multiple claims for the same event.

We’ve seen the same loss reported through two channels — phone and web — and no system warning appeared, creating a duplicate loss report that complicates our reserves and payments.
Duplicate loss reports are created because the system fails to warn about reports coming from multiple channels.

Also, repair updates missing — we’re on the phone daily with garages because there’s no live status.
Customers cannot see live repair updates, forcing them to call garages daily.

Just that we’re losing time daily on this — it’s not sustainable without better visibility and planning.
The team is losing time every day because they lack sufficient visibility and planning.

Hi Bryn, I’m having trouble accessing the documents section — it keeps timing out when I try to pull up reserves for policyholders.
The user cannot open the documents section because it times out when retrieving reserves for policyholders.

when we upload garage estimates, they’re landing in the wrong document category—like under Correspondence—and we’re having to manually move them, which risks things slipping through the cracks.
Garage estimate files are auto‑sorted into the wrong document category, requiring manual re‑assignment and risking missed evidence.

I’m having trouble accessing the claims module — it’s saying my login credentials aren’t valid.
The user cannot log into the claims module because their credentials are rejected.

Just confirming — does enterprise include unlimited integrations with garage systems?
The customer is unsure whether the enterprise plan includes unlimited integrations with garage systems.

Claims: click "Next"...Claims: click "Overview", dead x1
Clicking Next then trying to go to Overview results in a dead end.

Good morning, Deryn. I’m calling about our team’s daily frustrations with the system’s lack of live updates from garages.
The system does not provide live updates from garages, causing daily frustration.

Also, we’ve had a duplicate loss report issue — same incident logged twice, no alert triggered at intake.
Duplicate loss reports are created without triggering alerts.

We need predictability so our staff don’t have to keep relearning where things are.
Staff must constantly relearn where things are because the platform lacks predictability.

Tasks: click "Save", rage x3
The user repeatedly encounters errors when trying to save changes.

We’re getting renewal price concern from several of our biggest clients—they’re asking why their quotes increased so much, and it’s putting pressure on our retention team.
Clients are concerned that their renewal quotes have increased significantly, creating pressure on the retention team.

Great — we’ll be ready to go live once the upload files together issue is resolved.
The customer cannot go live because the system cannot upload files together.

Right now, we’re manually cross-checking every new claim to avoid the same claim twice, which eats up time we could spend on supplier coordination or reporting.
Manually cross-checking each new claim to prevent duplicates consumes excessive time.

Also, our finance team’s noticed the report totals differ — they’re comparing dashboard numbers with exported files and getting confused.
Report totals shown in the dashboard do not match the numbers in exported files, causing confusion.

It’s messy when the same claim twice comes in — one by phone, one online, and the system doesn’t flag it.
Duplicate claims submitted through different channels are not being identified by the system.

I need to reset my password for the claims portal as I’m locked out and can’t access documents or reserves.
The user is locked out of the claims portal and cannot access documents or reserves.

Claims: click "Link to existing claim", dead x1 ... Claims: click "Next"
The "Link to existing claim" button is broken, stopping users from linking a claim.

We need letters in Welsh for policyholders — it’s not just a nice-to-have, it’s tied to our renewal terms with Keelwater.
The customer lacks Welsh-language letters for policyholders, which is required for renewal terms.

Also, garage estimates keep landing in correspondence — we have to manually recategorise them, and sometimes evidence gets missed because of it.
Garage estimates are incorrectly routed to the correspondence category, requiring manual recategorization and causing evidence to be missed.

Your last update moved some controls without warning... Our teams had to retrain because of unexpected interface changes — and we’re still seeing errors from it.
Unexpected interface changes in the latest update forced the team to retrain and caused errors.

We’ve got a few questions about how claims get assigned to our teams.
The customer is unclear about how claims are assigned to their teams.

We’re still wrestling with how claim progress messages go out — it’s all manual right now and we’re behind on updates, so we’re relying on manual workarounds until automation lands.
Claim progress notifications are sent manually, causing delays and reliance on workarounds.

I’m trying to reconcile the latest reserves update with the payments we’ve processed for policyholders this week, and the numbers aren’t lining up.
The user cannot match the latest reserves update with the payments processed, resulting in a discrepancy.

Reports: click "Export CSV", error exception... Claims: click "Save"
Exporting a report to CSV triggers an error exception, preventing the download.

Claims: click "Link to existing claim", dead x1
The 'Link to existing claim' button does not work and leads to a dead link.
